shots.action: A close view of a bus window at night, the dark glass filling the frame with rain beaded across it. Droplets sit trembling in place, then gather weight, merge and begin to crawl downward in wavering silver trails, dragging thin wakes behind them. Beyond the wet pane the city has collapsed into soft out-of-focus discs of amber, white and cold blue light that hover and drift slightly as the vehicle moves. A faint dim reflection of the dark bus interior ghosts over the glass without resolving into anything.

out-of-focus city lights beyond the glass

shots.action: The same rain-streaked bus window holds in view as the vehicle carries it along the street. Long smeared streaks of streetlamps, shop signs and passing headlights rake across the wet glass, sliding sideways and stretching as they go. Individual droplets break apart under the sweep of light and re-form further along the pane, their shadows thickening and thinning, and the bokeh behind them flares briefly before fading back into the dark.
subjects: streetlights and shop signs sliding past outside
